subject: MAP: Load/perf test scheduling & next steps (Acme Retail)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Load/perf test scheduling & next steps (Acme Retail)

Hi Olivia —

Great to meet you and the Acme team earlier today. Per our discovery call, I summarized the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone we discussed around load/performance testing and dedicated capacity sizing. Draft MAP attached (20260625-acme-map-draft.pdf). Key items below so we can lock dates: 

- Objective: run a traffic-replay load test to validate latency & throughput at peak QPS and size dedicated capacity for production.
- Proposed target test window: early July (please share any blackout windows).
- Customer asks needed: traffic replay artifact (S3 link or sample), peak QPS and expected burst patterns, auth mechanism for replay, and any production safety constraints.
- Redwood deliverables: test plan, dedicated capacity recommendation (nodes / instance types), monitoring dashboard, fallback/failback plan, and a short post-test runbook.
- Target close date for contract: 2026-07-15 (subject to test results).

Next steps for you: please confirm available test windows and share a small traffic sample (or S3 path) and the peak QPS numbers. Marcus (SE) is looped for technical details and will propose sizing. Lauren will track commercial milestones.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai

Attachment: 20260625-acme-map-draft.pdf (MAP draft — 2 pages)
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acme-retail.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Load/perf test scheduling & next steps (Acme Retail)

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the summary and the MAP. Quick answers below: 

- Peak traffic: approx 1,200 QPS during promo peaks (sustained bursts ~10–15 min), baseline ~300 QPS.
- We can provide a traffic replay archive (anonymized), currently in S3; I will share a sample payload and a small subset of logs for initial validation.
- Preferred test window: week of July 6–9 (we can do overnight windows to avoid production impact).
- Safety: we need the test routed to a dedicated environment (no PII), and a clear rollback plan if latency > 500ms 95th perc.

Marcus — I'll upload a small sample to S3 tonight and share link/creds. For sizing, open to Redwood's recommendation — we want to err on the side of headroom but keep costs reasonable.

Olivia Chen
Head of Platform Engineering | Acme Retail
olivia.chen@acme-retail.com

Attachment: acme-traffic-sample.tar.gz (sample payload, 120MB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acme-retail.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Load/perf test scheduling & next steps (Acme Retail)

Hi Olivia + Neha —

Thanks — this is helpful. Draft technical plan and asks below (feel free to edit):

- Acceptance criteria (pre-test):
  * Traffic replay artifact uploaded to a secure S3 bucket and reachable by Redwood test runners.
  * Sample of request/response size distributions + any auth headers/methods.
  * Definition of success: 95th percentile latency < 300ms at peak QPS; error rate < 0.5%.

- Test plan (high-level):
  * Warm-up phase: ramp to 30% of peak over 10 mins to populate KV cache.
  * Ramp phase: increase to 100% peak over 20 mins including burst patterns.
  * Soak phase: sustain peak for 15 mins (replicating promo pattern).

- Redwood deliverables: test harness (traffic-replay), monitoring dashboards, kernel/config tuning recommendations, and a dedicated capacity recommendation.

- Preliminary sizing: based on your 1,200 QPS peak and the payload sizes in the sample, I recommend starting with a 4-node dedicated pool (A10G-equivalent GPUs) with continuous batching configured and prefix cache enabled. We'll validate during the test and adjust.

- Proposed exact test window: Jul 7, 2026 02:00–06:00 PDT (minimal traffic in your region). Please confirm or suggest alternatives.

- Required access: S3 path + short-lived IAM role or presigned URL; a service account token for Redwood to authenticate to your staging API (scoped).

I'll create a calendar invite and a short pre-test checklist. If you prefer, we can also run a smaller smoke test the day before to validate connectivity.

Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/abc123

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acme-retail.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Load/perf test scheduling & next steps (Acme Retail)

Thanks Marcus / Neha —

Jul 7 02:00–06:00 PDT works for us. We'll: 
- Provide S3 presigned URL for the traffic-replay bundle by end of day Jun 27.
- Create a scoped service account token for staging and share via our secure vault (I'll send the access steps to Marcus).
- Confirm target close date (we're aligned on 2026-07-15 — will aim to complete procurement paperwork ASAP).

A smoke test on Jul 6 would be helpful. Please send the pre-test checklist and invite; I'll RSVP.

Olivia
